Title: Senior Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Developer
Description: DARE TO BE A PART OF THE CHALLENGE! COME AND JOIN OUR TEAM TOGETHER WE CAN MAKE THE DIFFERENCE! Did you know that Accenture is leading the digital transformation in the World? Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Our main purpose is to collaborate with our clients, so they can become high-performance businesses. Accenture is present in more than 200 offices, 120 cities, 56 countries and approximately 743,000 employees worldwide. Offer Career development according to your profile and interests. Work in one of the best companies and feel proud. Access to an innovative methodology and tools. Direct contact with experts worldwide. Use of work schemes and cutting-edge technologies. Constant training. Work environment based on teamwork and collaboration. Participation in International Projects 🚀 Senior Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Developer Are you passionate about building enterprise-level digital experiences? We are looking for a Senior Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Developer to join our team and help design, develop, and deliver scalable, high-quality solutions for global clients. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and working with modern DevSecOps practices, we'd love to hear from you. 🎯 What You'll Do 💻 Design, develop, and test custom software solutions using Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). 🏗️ Develop scalable components, services, and integrations across multiple applications. 🔄 Design and implement application integration solutions and APIs. 📐 Translate business and system requirements into technical designs and development specifications. 🚀 Support application deployments and production releases. ✅ Write clean, maintainable, and high-quality code following development standards and best practices. 🤝 Collaborate with architects, developers, QA engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver innovative digital experiences. 🔐 Apply DevSecOps principles throughout the software development lifecycle. 🛠️ Required Qualifications ✔️ Advanced experience with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM). ✔️ Strong Java development experience. ✔️ Experience with Apache Sling, OSGi, HTL (Sightly), Sling Models, and JCR. ✔️ Experience building RESTful APIs and system integrations. ✔️ Proficiency with Maven, Git, and modern development tools. ✔️ Advanced knowledge of DevSecOps practices. ✔️ Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar). ✔️ Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud deployment environments is a plus. ✔️ Advanced English proficiency (spoken and written) is required. ✔️ Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. 📍 Work Location 🌎 Candidates located anywhere in Mexico are welcome to apply. 🏢 Candidates based in Monterrey or Mexico City must be open to working in a hybrid model, attending the office as required. ⭐ Preferred Qualifications Experience with Adobe Cloud Manager. Knowledge of Adobe Experience Cloud products. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team. 🌟 What You'll Bring Passion for technology and continuous learning. Strong ownership and accountability. A proactive mindset with excellent problem-solving abilities. The ability to thrive in a collaborative and fast-paced environment. A commitment to delivering high-quality, secure, and scalable software solutions. 💙 Why Join Us? 🚀 Work on enterprise-scale digital transformation projects. 🌎 Collaborate with talented global teams. 📚 Continuous learning and professional development opportunities. 💡 Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and modern engineering practices. 🎯 Make a real impact by delivering exceptional digital experiences.
